roll.note: Each Wind Release jutsu you cast (not the action that spends it). Up to 4 (6 at 11th); each lasts 1 minute.
As part of casting a Wind Release jutsu: it gains the Swirl effect.

rules.text: The Divine Wind chakra stance (Bonus action), with two forms you swap at the start of your turns; in either you float 1 foot up and take no falling damage from 50 feet or less. Pressure Front: High Pressure (the pool), Swirl, and your Hijutsu gain the listed critical effects. Razor Jet: each Wind Release jutsu marks one affected creature with Low Pressure for 1 minute; spend it when you damage it to push it 10 feet; Wind Release area jutsu can be a Jet Needle (5 by 30 feet, −2 to saves, +30 feet at 7th, 11th and 15th) or a Cleave (a line between two points within 60 feet, creatures within 5 feet save; failure: +1 rank of Bleed).

roll.note: A Wind Release jutsu targeting a creature with Low Pressure (spend it too): its effects land before the creature's reaction, even an Interrupt.

activities.label: Vortex Burst: fly (2 High Pressure)
activities.text: A fly speed equal to your speed until the end of your next turn.

roll.note: Until the start of your next turn, your weapon deals this extra wind damage.

activities.label: Blade Spiral: Low Pressure reaction
activities.text: Reaction, a creature with Low Pressure attacks you in melee: spend its pressure (slashing or wind).

activities.label: Storm Wall: wind shield (2 High Pressure)
activities.text: As part of casting a Wind Release jutsu: temporary hit points until the start of your next turn.

roll.note: Dealing wind or slashing damage: the creature's DR is 2 lower per High Pressure spent (up to 2) until the start of your next turn.

activities.label: Rending Jetstream: tendons
activities.text: Reaction, a creature with Low Pressure casts a Mobility jutsu: spend its pressure. Failure: 1 rank of Bleed and Shaken.

rules.text: One Wind Whisper (more at 7th and 15th). Vortex Burst: Wind Release areas and Swirls +5 feet (+10 at 11th); Low Pressure: on a failed save, slam it Prone with speed 0 until the end of its next turn. Blade Spiral: with an Action Hijutsu that inflicts Bleed, a Bonus action triggers Swirl and its creatures save too (+1 rank of Bleed). Storm Wall: your Wind Release Barriers gain 4 DR (6 at 11th); casting dispels vapors and gases within 10 feet; Low Pressure halves a Barrier's hit points or DR. Whispering Breeze: Auditory Genjutsu affect deafened creatures and Inhale ones affect creatures holding breath; High Pressure: a failed save also Deafens and Dazes until the end of its next turn; Low Pressure: it suffers the Critical Failure instead. Rending Jetstream: casting a Fūshin Hijutsu, move up to 20 feet without provoking.
10 minutes of focus: for 1 hour, whisper with creatures of your choice you can see within 90 feet (you hear their whispers too). Blocked by walls 1 inch thick; ends for creatures you lose sight of.

The Divine Wind chakra stance (its text is Divine Winds' stance part, King Q-E9): Pressure Front and Razor Jet forms, swapped at the start of your turns; the High Pressure buttons are on Divine Winds.
